question: Within taxa sharing an identical six-anthocyanidin-presence state and after adjustment for measured pigment amounts, is historical structure in 21-gene expression limited to late anthocyanin execution, or also detectable in other functionally annotated parts of the flavonoid pathway?

frame.safeguard: Preserve exact original same-tree taxa, six-bit pigment states, 183 same-state unordered taxon pairs and all 21 gene axes, no output-driven gene/taxon filtering

functionally_mapped_nonoverlapping_modul.role: late anthocyanin hydroxylation, reduction, stabilization, modification, and transport; includes branch F3'5'H and anthocyanin enzymes
flavonol branch biochemical reaction and documented flavonol-associated MYB activators; F3'H also acts at hydroxylation junction
early shared structural pathway together with positive/negative higher-level transcriptional regulatory factors, includes Antho regulator AN1 and MYB27; NOT an unrelated negative control

expression_and_chemistry_residualization.expression: For all 47 species, transform each of 21 raw source TPM10K features with log1p, z-standardize across species (population sd).
expression_and_chemistry_residualization.chemistry: All nine original anthocyanidin and flavonol mg/g columns transformed log1p(100*x) and z-scaled; three fixed zero-variance anthocyanidins assigned zeros.
expression_and_chemistry_residualization.projector: Exactly the previously checked full 47x47 projector M = I - D pinv(D) with six source fine-state dummy columns and all nine source measured pigment abundance columns; residualize whole 21-column expression matrix before extracting any module.
expression_and_chemistry_residualization.gene_module_vectors: Select all fixed members of each non-overlapping module from M@full standardized expression matrix; recompute RMS across module genes for the same original 183 species pairs. This is not adjusted anew per module.

permutation.source_study_type: Post-outcome source-exposed, new module statistics fixed before opening this particular source-matched comparison. Retrospective exploratory only.
permutation.unit: Whole 21-gene residual expression vector assigned to a species; permute species within original six-bit fine-class groups only; NEVER permute pair observations or independent gene columns.
permutation.procedure: For each whole-vector shuffle within fine states, compute M @ permuted original residual vectors. For each of the 3 fixed modules compute the Spearman rho between source tree patristic ranks and within-exact-state module residual-expression RMS distances.
permutation.one_sided_p_formula: (1 + number of permuted module rho>=observed module rho)/(10000)
permutation.familywise_maxT: For each permutation, take max of all 3 module rho statistics; adjusted p per module=(1+number of permuted maximum rho >= that module's observed rho)/10000. Controls three positive-tail module tests under the complete no-signal permutation null, not a test of biological module-effect equality.
permutation.interpretation: rho>0 and maxT-adjusted p<=0.05 is an exploratory signal for within-state phylogenetic organization of that group; otherwise NOT_SUPPORTED in this source. Statistical module-vs-module difference is NOT tested.

report.per_module_show: source gene names, gene count, full rho, null mean, centered rho, 2.5–97.5% null range, nominal P, maxT-adjusted P, number of source fixed species pairs
report.claim_scope: We can establish which functional sets show detectable taxon-level phylogenetic conservation after pigment adjustment in this ONE radiation, not determine whether pigment-module specificity exceeds general transcriptome-wide phylogenetic conservation.
